data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘leon’, meaning ‘lion’. The name Leonerd signifies a brave and powerful individual, like a lion in the wild. The name Leonerd carries the meaning “Lion brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leonerd usually hope their child will grow to embody lion brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
